historyParagraph1: Chelsea Muslim Community was established to serve the growing Muslim population of SW10 — a neighbourhood defined by its remarkable diversity, the long shadow of the World's End Estate, and a quiet determination among its residents to build something lasting. From the earliest Friday prayers held in borrowed spaces, CMC grew into a permanent home: 14 Blantyre Street, a place as familiar to our congregation as their own sitting rooms.
historyParagraph2: Our community reflects the mosaic of West London: Moroccans and Somalis, South Asians and Egyptians, converts and cradle Muslims, working families and students from Imperial College, long-settled Chelsea residents and new arrivals still learning the city's rhythms. What unites us is not background but faith — and a shared commitment to this patch of London.
historyParagraph3: Over the years, CMC has grown from a space of prayer into a full community institution — Quran classes, welfare support, nikah ceremonies, janazah services, interfaith engagement, and an annual Ramadan programme that brings hundreds together each evening. We remain proudly local, deliberately un-institutional, and utterly committed to the community that made us.
missionStatement: Chelsea Muslim Community exists to nurture faith, strengthen community, and serve all people — guided by Islamic values and rooted in the life of SW10.
principle1Description: We are grounded in Islamic belief and practice — the five pillars, the Quran, and the Sunnah are our compass. Everything we do flows from a sincere relationship with Allah.
principle2Description: We exist for our community — not as an institution, but as a home. CMC is wherever our congregation gathers: in the prayer hall, at the iftar table, at a neighbour's door.
principle3Description: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "The best of people are those most beneficial to others." Service — to the mosque, to the vulnerable, to Chelsea — is how we honour that teaching.
values: Faith & Devotion,Community & Belonging,Service & Generosity,Dignity & Respect,Knowledge & Growth
